coverage_note: Issuer/FDA-sourced scheduled catalysts, each re-fetched and quote-checked by biotech_review.py within the last 7 days. Coverage is partial: an absent name is not evidence of no upcoming catalyst.

events.known_data: The upLIFT study is evaluating ersodetug for tumor HI, and results could support a potential pre-BLA meeting if positive.
events.new_information: The company expects to report topline results from the Phase 3 upLIFT study in tumor HI during the current quarter.
events.read_throughs: Topline results from upLIFT may influence the overall BLA submission strategy for both tumor HI and congenital HI.
events.source_quote: On track to report topline results for the Phase 3 upLIFT study in tumor HI this quarter

events.known_data: FDA previously granted INO-3107 orphan drug and breakthrough therapy designations; the issuer says the FDA had not discussed its preliminary comment on accelerated-approval eligibility and that feedback on the confirmatory trial design would be forthcoming.
events.new_information: Issuer reports the late-cycle review meeting and all scheduled pre-licensure inspections are complete, toward an October 30, 2026 PDUFA target action date.
events.read_throughs: A binary regulatory decision on the issuer's lead asset; the issuer states it is preparing a commercial launch. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: The FDA's review of the BLA for INO-3107 continues to advance under the agency's accelerated approval program toward a PDUFA target action date of October 30, 2026.
events.stage: BLA under FDA review (accelerated approval program)

events.known_data: Positive data from the Phase 2/3 study were announced in April 2026, with ORR of 18.0% in the tovecimig combination arm.
events.new_information: Tovecimig data from the Phase 2/3 study in BTC has been selected for an oral presentation at the ESMO Congress in October 2026.
events.source_quote: Tovecimig data from this study has also been selected for an oral presentation at the 2026 European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress in October.

events.known_data: The release notes that prior Invivyd monoclonal antibody data from EVADE and CANOPY, along with LIBERTY data, may be part of the evidence base.
events.new_information: The release states that DECLARATION topline data on safety and immunogenicity are now expected in October to support the BLA submission.
events.read_throughs: Positive DECLARATION topline safety and immunogenicity data are needed for the planned Accelerated Approval submission.
events.source_quote: DECLARATION topline data on safety and immunogenicity to support the submission are now expected in October

events.known_data: The release mentions the CARLYSLE trial is ongoing and has previously reported data, but does not detail prior results.
events.new_information: The release states that longer-term follow-up data, including safety and efficacy results with up to 20 months follow-up in adults and at least 3 months in adolescents, will be presented.
events.source_quote: Updated data from the ongoing Phase 1 CARLYSLE trial in patients with severe refractory systemic lupus erythematosus (srSLE) will be presented in a poster on November 10.

events.known_data: The release does not disclose prior data from the ALARIC trial.
events.new_information: The release states that initial data from the ongoing Phase 1 ALARIC trial are expected by the end of 2026.
events.source_quote: The Phase 1 ALARIC trial evaluating AUTO8 in light-chain amyloidosis is ongoing and initial data are expected to be reported at the end of 2026.

events.known_data: No clinical efficacy data reported; the issuer describes continued enrollment of the first cohort.
events.new_information: Topline data from the first cohort of the Phase 1/2 trial expected in Q4 2026.
events.read_throughs: An early first-cohort readout on the issuer's lead clinical program. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: Topline data from first cohort of Phase 1/2 trial expected in Q4-2026

events.known_data: None stated in the release.
events.new_information: Initial clinical data from the Phase 1 study of CTX-10726 are expected in Q4 2026.
events.source_quote: The first patients have been dosed in the Phase 1 study, and the study is actively enrolling, with initial clinical data expected in Q4 2026.

events.known_data: LUGANO, the first of the two pivotal Phase 3 wet AMD trials, reported topline data on 2026-08-17; the issuer describes stable retinal anatomy through Week 56.
events.new_information: Topline data from LUCIA, the second wet AMD pivotal Phase 3 trial, expected in Q4 2026; the issuer anticipates potentially filing an NDA in 1H 2027.
events.read_throughs: The second pivotal readout gates the planned NDA. The DME trials (COMO, CAPRI) read out separately in Q4 2027 and are outside this window. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: The Company remains on track to report topline data from the second wet AMD pivotal Phase 3 LUCIA trial in the fourth quarter of 2026.

events.known_data: The release notes that enrollment in the 40 mg cohort of SENTRY-2 is ongoing, following completion of enrollment of the 60 mg cohort (n=29) earlier this year.
events.new_information: The release states that topline data from the Phase 2 SENTRY-2 60 mg cohort are expected in the second half of 2026.
events.source_quote: Topline data from the Phase 2 SENTRY-2 60 mg cohort expected in the second half of 2026.

events.known_data: LX2020 has received RMAT designation and is generally well tolerated in ten participants with no clinically significant complement activation.
events.new_information: A 12-month data update for all high dose participants from the Phase I/II trial is expected in Q4 2026.
events.read_throughs: RMAT designation may expedite development of LX2020.
events.source_quote: 12-month data update for all high dose participants in Q4 2026

events.known_data: NMRA-511 is a Vasopressin 1a Receptor Antagonist.
events.new_information: The company plans to report data from the MAD expansion cohort in Q4 2026 and initiate a Phase 2 study in AD agitation by end of 2026.
events.source_quote: Neumora plans to report data from a MAD expansion cohort evaluating higher doses of NMRA-511 in healthy elderly participants in the fourth quarter of 2026 and to initiate a Phase 2 study with NMRA-511 in Alzheimer's disease agitation by the end of 2026.

events.known_data: NMRA-898 is an M4 Positive Allosteric Modulator.
events.new_information: The company expects to report data from the MAD study in the second half of 2026.
events.source_quote: Neumora is conducting a MAD study with NMRA-898 in healthy volunteers and patients with stable schizophrenia and expects to report data from the study in the second half of 2026.

events.known_data: Phase 1 results thus far have been encouraging.
events.new_information: The company intends to initiate a ketamine challenge study in the second half of 2026.
events.source_quote: Building on the encouraging Phase 1 results thus far and as a part of the clinical development plan, Ovid intends to initiate a ketamine challenge study of OV4071 in the second half of 2026 to further characterize potential pharmacodynamic effects and proof-of-mechanism using electrophysiology and biomarkers.

events.known_data: The photo stimulation study has been initiated with regulatory clearances to evaluate the anti-convulsant effect of multiple doses of OV329.
events.new_information: Results from the photosensitivity study are anticipated near year end 2026.
events.source_quote: The Company intends to test three doses of OV329, including 5, 7 and 9 milligrams, and anticipates results near year end 2026.

events.indication: Patients dependent on long-term parenteral support
events.known_data: The release does not state prior efficacy data for this trial in this sentence, but describes IV Choline Chloride as an investigational therapy with Orphan Drug designation.
events.new_information: The release states the company is on track to report interim results from the THRIVE-3 registrational trial in Q4 2026.
events.read_throughs: Interim results may support regulatory submissions or further development.
events.source_quote: On track to report interim results from THRIVE-3 registrational trial of IV Choline Chloride in patients dependent on long-term parenteral support in 4Q 2026

events.known_data: Interim data on six patients (two dose cohorts) presented at ASGCT: PVC count fell in all patients, mean -64% from baseline; no dose-limiting toxicities. EMA PRIME designation May 2026.
events.new_information: Additional interim RIDGE-1 data expected in Q4 2026; enrollment needed to characterise dose response is complete.
events.read_throughs: An update on a small open-label cohort, not a controlled readout. The issuer separately plans a TN-201 regulatory update in Q4 2026. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: Tenaya expects to report additional interim data from the RIDGE-1 clinical trial in the fourth quarter of 2026.

events.known_data: Prior interim data demonstrated reductions in hypertrophy and symptom burden improvements, with generally well-tolerated safety in both dose cohorts.
events.new_information: The release announces plans to report additional interim data from MyPEAK-1 in Q4 2026.
events.source_quote: Tenaya plans to report additional interim data from the MyPEAK-1 clinical trial in the fourth quarter of 2026.

events.known_data: No efficacy readout from TibuSHIELD has been reported. A separate Phase 2 in systemic sclerosis (TibuSURE) reads out in H1 2027.
events.new_information: TibuSHIELD completed enrollment with 247 participants, above target; topline data expected in Q4 2026.
events.read_throughs: First controlled efficacy data for the issuer's lead asset. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: Topline data from TibuSHIELD are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.

events.known_data: Prior data include NPP results showing encouraging Overall Survival, safety, and quality of life in 57 patients, and interim DURIPANC reports of immune system changes with combination therapy well-tolerated and high quality of life.
events.new_information: The release states that final Ampligen dosing in the Phase 2 DURIPANC trial is complete, and topline results are expected in Q1 2027.
events.source_quote: The study has completed final Ampligen dosing, representing an important clinical milestone as the program advances toward topline results expected in the first quarter of 2027.

events.known_data: The release states the trial is ongoing and provides no prior efficacy data.
events.new_information: 26-week primary endpoint data expected in the first quarter of 2027.
events.source_quote: The trial is currently enrolling patients, with 26-week primary endpoint data expected in the first quarter of 2027.

events.known_data: OCU400 completed enrollment in the liMeliGhT registrational trial with 140 patients and holds orphan drug designation.
events.new_information: Topline results for OCU400 in retinitis pigmentosa are expected in the first quarter of 2027.
events.read_throughs: Positive topline results could support a rolling BLA submission for OCU400 in retinitis pigmentosa.
events.source_quote: Remain on track to announce top-line results for two late-stage clinical programs, OCU400 for RP and OCU410ST for Stargardt disease in 1Q 2027 and 2Q 2027, respectively
